title: The Boy Who Believes He Reincarnated as a Villain in a World Where the Gender Ratio Is Completely Skewed
description: One day, when a young man wakes up… he finds himself in a luxurious mansion surrounded by beautiful maids. After reincarnating as Hazumi Reito, the heir to a prestigious family, he interprets the attitude of those around him as a sign that he has been reincarnated into the role of a villain. Convinced of this, he desperately rushes to avoid every destruction flag. However, what he still doesn’t know is that… this world has an extremely unbalanced gender ratio heavily favoring women, and he is an incredibly rare and valuable man to all of those beautiful women. A misunderstanding-filled reverse romantic comedy begins!
author: Pondo Daikimera
